plain: Strong and convincing, hard to argue against

webster.text: Forcible, in a physical sense; as the cogent force of nature.

more.text: Urgent; pressing on the mind; forcible; powerful; not easily resisted; as a cogent reason, or argument.

example.quote: The more attentively I consider and investigate the reasons which appear to have given birth to this opinion, the more I become convinced that they are cogent and conclusive.
